scope: Coordinator preliminary mathematical boundary review; no new Lean or symbolic replay

facts.claim: A unital homomorphism from AmbientDerivation.K to a nontrivial curve field cannot send AmbientDerivation.G to zero
facts.evidence: AmbientDerivation.G_ne_zero plus injectivity of field homomorphisms
facts.consequence: Use a polynomial map or localization at a multiplicative set whose images are units.

facts.claim: The old normal derivation cannot descend with unchanged coordinate values
facts.consequence: Keep tangent/Kahler pullback separate from the normal ambient derivation.

facts.claim: The U=x^2 chart is already a quotient by the reflection coordinate change
facts.evidence: ChartSubstitution.protected_substitution identifies F at x with z^6+cubic(x^2,r,w,t)
facts.consequence: A field containing U,r,w,t,z alone requires an explicit scope statement; recovering original X0 requires adjoining a square root or working in x coordinates.

facts.claim: A chosen algebraic root can realize a component while retaining injective parameter base
facts.evidence: Any field extension of the rational parameter field embeds that field, but irreducibility of z^6+cubic is a separate obligation
facts.consequence: Do not label a selected-root/component model the entire physical hypersurface function field unless irreducibility/generic completeness is proved.

status: SUPPORTING REVIEW; final implementation not yet available
